verdict.rationale: Asana's REST API reference documents a built-in, in-context API explorer on every endpoint, so users can make live requests and see responses directly from the docs. The llms.txt probe confirms a dedicated 'API explorer' guide in the getting-started docs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of pre-filled or multi-language runnable code examples beyond the request explorer, and independent hands-on corroboration of the explorer working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Each API endpoint features a built-in, in-context API explorer through which you can make requests (and see responses).
Each API endpoint features a built-in, in-context [API explorer](https://developers.asana.com/docs/api-explorer) through which you can make requests (and see responses).
